TRAPS HIT AND AVOIDED THIS RUN
1. Yahoo daily bars have a NULL for Tue 22 Sep on EVERY instrument (^FTSE, ^GSPC, ^TNX, ^VIX).
   Reading "the bar before Wednesday" therefore returns MONDAY and understates the day's move.
   This is what made VIX look +2.5% instead of the true +6.83%.
2. Yahoo BZ=F has ALREADY ROLLED to Dec'26 (98.66) while the front month is still Nov'26
   (103.65). Yahoo's apparent -4.3% is a roll artefact.
3. CNBC's .VIX change fields were stale (change "UNCH", open 0.00) - do not use.
4. CNBC's gilt previous_day_closing (5.3511%) is again NOT Tuesday's close; MarketWatch /
   Tullett Prebon is the reliable gilt source (stamped "Sep 23, 2026 5:00 p.m. BST").
